messages.subject: indents, tabs, line length, etc.
parts:
I'm going crazy with the indents, tabs, line lengths,
etc.

Please please:

*** use 2 spaces for indents, NOT tabs

*** use line lengths < 80 chars if at all possible
--- break on operators (start new lines with operators)
--- break on arguments (end previous line with comma)

*** space around operators
--- don't use "a||c"
--- do use "a || c"
--- especially when a and c are 50-character long expressions!!!

I'm actually not that picky about paren style, but
I prefer not having any open parens on their own lines.

- Bob
